# Shieldio

> Shieldio is a Czech student electronics project. RED V4 is being tested and V5 is in preparation; the board is not currently on sale. Green, Yellow and PRO are concepts. Public guides, the component reference and a local Arduino compiler/uploader are available on the website. Most pages support Czech and English.

## Program RED

- [Shieldio editor](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/blokovy-editor.html): RED module blocks, universal Arduino pin blocks and manual C++; local AVR GCC WebAssembly compilation and direct Web Serial USB upload in desktop Chrome/Edge. Target: classic Nano / ATmega328P, 16 MHz. No mBlock or local helper is required.
- [First upload](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/programovani/): LED blink starter, serial port selection, compilation, upload and troubleshooting.
- Included libraries: ShieldioDisplay, Servo, Wire, SPI, Adafruit GFX and SSD1306. Imported AVR header/C++ libraries remain in the browser tab. C, assembly and precompiled library imports are not supported.
- First use downloads compiler assets from jsDelivr and Blockly from unpkg. Source code is not sent to a remote compilation server. Offline availability is not guaranteed. Other boards are not upload targets.

## How to read the public guides

- To receive the readable Markdown representation, request any page with `Accept: text/markdown`. Plain HTML is returned by default.
- The assembly guide and the barrier, parking assistant, timer and theremin guides include complete text instructions and troubleshooting even when JavaScript is unavailable. The interactive step-by-step guide remains available to browsers.
- Assembly and component positions documented for RED V3 must not be assumed to apply to RED V4. For revision-specific work, verify the board version first.

## Build and projects

- [Component reference](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/baseline/red/prehled/): PCB positions, values, polarity and signal pins.
- [Assembly](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/baseline/red/sestaveni/): soldering and inspection photo guide.
- [RED projects](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/baseline/red/): barrier, parking assistant, timer, theremin, distance meter and scanning radar. Radar requires additional mechanics and wiring.
- [Electronics explanations](https://shieldio.cz/instructions/jak-to-funguje/): Ohm’s law, LED/diode, capacitors, PWM, pull-ups/debounce, ultrasonic sensing and PCBs.

## Status and teaching

- [Board overview](https://shieldio.cz/products/): current prototype/concept status; interest is non-binding, not an order.
- [Teacher preparation](https://shieldio.cz/company/pro-ucitele.html): school computer checks and a draft lesson.
- [Barrier lesson plan](https://shieldio.cz/company/metodika-zavora.html): 45/90 minute proposals, worksheet and rubric, to adapt to the school’s conditions.
- [About](https://shieldio.cz/company/about.html): the author and development status.
- [FAQ](https://shieldio.cz/faq.html), [news](https://shieldio.cz/aktuality/), [contact](https://shieldio.cz/company/contact.html).

## Shieldio Learn

- [AI index studijních materiálů](https://learn.shieldio.cz/llms.txt): veřejné maturitní materiály a Markdown reprezentace na samostatné subdoméně.
- [Maturita – automatizace](https://learn.shieldio.cz/maturita/automatizace/): veřejné okruhy. Elektronika v beta režimu není veřejně přístupná.

## Další veřejné subdomény

- [Shieldio Sim](https://simulation.shieldio.cz/): interaktivní simulátor elektrických obvodů, číslicové logiky a FBD.
- [Light](https://light.shieldio.cz/): iniciativy odpovědného venkovního osvětlení.
- [Luxmaxing](https://luxmaxing.shieldio.cz/): světelné podmínky ve školách.
- [Flight360](https://flight360.shieldio.cz/): 360° letecké prohlídky.
